Scenario: On a machine without Docker, the installer names what to install and goes on to the setup questions

g.text: Given a developer's machine has neither Docker nor Podman
A fresh machine where the toolbox will be installed. The shell finds neither docker nor
podman, the two programs that run containers.
When the developer starts the installer, it warns that Docker is
missing, says where to get it, and goes on to the setup questions
The developer starts the installer and, asked what to install, picks the complete framework.
Before it sets anything up, the installer warns: "Docker does not answer on this machine: it
The next two lines say why it matters, task code, task build and task test run their tools in
containers, and where to get Docker. Then the installer goes on: Copier asks its first setup
